layout.short_title: Wie Claude eine Aufgabe abarbeitet EN
layout.description: Real run, recorded on Nov 2, 2026 with Claude Code 2.1.309 (model claude-haiku-5-5). A test fails because a function subtracts instead of adding. With node test.js allowed, Claude ran the test, read the error, changed one line and tested again: TEST OK. Without Bash, Claude fixed the bug too, but could not verify it and said so.
layout.companion_text: Base command per run: claude -p "<Prompt>" --model haiku --output-format stream-json --verbose --setting-sources project,local --strict-mcp-config --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --tools Read,Edit,Bash,Grep,Glob. Run 1 also --allowedTools "Bash(node test.js)" and --permission-mode acceptEdits, run 2 without Bash. Source: Claude Code docs, How Claude Code works, retrieved Nov 2, 2026. Paths shortened in the frame (test folder = .). Behaviour can change with version and model. Not an official Anthropic channel.

beats.spoken: What does Claude Code actually do when you say: the test fails, fix the bug? One real run, step by step, and a second one without the shell.
The test folder holds two files: a function called summe and a test that checks whether two plus three gives five. The bug is planted on purpose: the function subtracts instead of adding.
According to the docs, Claude works in three phases: gather context, take action and verify results. The phases blend into each other, and Claude uses tools throughout.

data.kicker: Claude Code docs, How Claude Code works
data.quote: … it works through three phases: gather context, take action, and verify results.
data.translation: Gather context, act, check the result.

beats.spoken: Run one. A first combined command was not approved. Then Claude ran the test and saw minus one instead of five. It read summe.js, changed one line and ran the test again. TEST OK.

Run two, same task, but without Bash. Claude read the test and the function, fixed the bug and tried to start the test. The tool was missing. Claude wrote that the bug was fixed, but that it could not run the test.
The file after the run: minus became plus. Claude changed only this one line and left the rest of the file as it was.
Both runs ran twice, with the same result. Claude fixed the bug every time. It was only verified in run one, because only there did the test actually run.

data.headline: 2 runs, twice each
data.note: Gather context, act, verify: three phases, per the docs.
data.note_source: Claude Code docs, How Claude Code works

beats.spoken: So give Claude the tool it needs to check its own work, not just the tools to change it. Follow Promptwerk for more Claude workflows, step by step.

data.statement: Let Claude verify, not just edit.
